svg.title: Figure 13. Package Diagram
svg.desc: The program has groups for screens, staff actions, entry checks, and saved records. Experimental Record Review runs in the website; model training is a separate preparation step.

g.text: Simplified program groups; arrows show which part uses another
Review screen + date checks + saved model
Uses recorded dates; shows patterns for staff to review
Model training is separate from daily system use
